name: Warhorse (Chain Mail Barding)
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 11. No listed skills, special senses or languages.
appearance: A sturdy light-bay warhorse with a black mane and tail, dark lower legs, and fitted chain mail barding in this variant.

sections.Printed source:
Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), Appendix A, printed p. 340, Warhorse and Variant: Warhorse Armor. https://online.anyflip.com/pqhqn/sezy/index.html#p=341
Official Monster Manual errata v2.0 corrects Hooves from +4 to +6 to hit.
sections.Barding: Chain Mail barding gives AC 16 under the printed Warhorse Armor table. Use the fixed AC for this heavy barding. The armor gives disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The warhorse's Strength 18 meets the armor's Strength 13 requirement for full speed. See the 2014 Player's Handbook armor rules, pp. 144–145.
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Hooves on the same turn. The creature makes a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure, it falls prone. If the creature is prone, the horse can follow up with another Hooves attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: A rider controlling the warhorse can have it Dash, Disengage, or Dodge. An independent mount acts on its own initiative and can use its listed attacks.
